Submagic vs VEXI: Short-Video Editor or Full Social Studio
Submagic and VEXI, side by side: what each one does and what it costs, from each company's own pages.

Submagic is an AI editor that turns your raw videos into captioned shorts and publishes them [1][3]. VEXI makes and posts your social content. They overlap on short video, and in many ways they fit together.

Submagic is an AI editor for short-form video [1]. You upload a raw video and its AI agents add captions, cuts, B-roll, zooms and music; Magic Clips turn one long video into several shorts [1]. It publishes and schedules to TikTok, Instagram Reels and Stories and YouTube Shorts; scheduling for a later date needs Pro or Business [3]. Starter is $19 a month, or $12 a month billed yearly; Pro is $39 ($23 yearly) and Business is $69 ($41 yearly) [2].

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

Submagic edits the footage you upload and posts it [1][3]. The difference is everything around the video. VEXI also designs posts and carousels, writes the captions, makes long-form video, posts to more of your accounts, and Autopilot runs your week. VEXI costs more than Submagic: plans are $199, $399 or $599 a month [2]. What you pay for is the work you no longer do.
Submagic makes short-form video: it adds captions, cuts, B-roll, zooms and music to your footage, and can turn one long video into several shorts [1].
VEXI designs the post with your logo, colors, fonts and voice. Tap anything on the design to change it.
Submagic publishes and schedules to TikTok, Instagram Reels and Stories and YouTube Shorts. Its page says LinkedIn, Facebook and X are on the way and not live yet [3].
VEXI posts to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads and your Google Business Profile.
You pick a template or a video whose style you like, upload your raw footage, and Submagic’s AI agents make the first edit; you can adjust any element in the editor [1].
VEXI Autopilot runs your week ahead: it writes, cuts and posts, and can wait for your approval on everything.
Edits your own footage: cuts, B-roll, music, captions
A quick way to caption and polish the short videos you upload, and to publish or schedule them to TikTok, Instagram and YouTube Shorts [1][3].
One app: you ask, and it writes, designs, edits the video and posts it. Autopilot runs your week ahead.
Does Submagic post to social media?

Yes. Submagic publishes and schedules to TikTok, Instagram Reels and Stories and YouTube Shorts; scheduling for a later date needs Pro or Business [3]. Its page says Facebook, LinkedIn and X are not live yet [3]. VEXI posts to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads and your Google Business Profile.

Submagic makes short-form video: captions, cuts, B-roll, zooms and music on the footage you upload, and Magic Clips that turn a long video into several shorts [1]. VEXI also designs posts and carousels in your logo, colors and fonts, and writes their captions.

Submagic’s Starter is $19 a month ($12 a month billed yearly) for 15 captioned videos up to 2 minutes, Pro is $39 ($23) for 40 videos up to 5 minutes, and Business is $69 ($41) for 100 videos up to 30 minutes [2].
